description_en: Decodes the permission diagnostic information from the response body of a request that was denied due to missing RAM permissions
description_zh: 从因无RAM权限导致的请求被拒绝访问的响应体中解码无权限诊断信息
name: DecodeDiagnosticMessage

parameters.help_en: The encoded diagnostic message obtained from the `AccessDeniedDetail.EncodedDiagnosticMessage` field in the response body when an API request is denied due to insufficient permissions. Pass this parameter to decode the permission diagnostic information when calling this operation
parameters.help_zh: API请求因无权限被拒绝访问时，从响应体 `AccessDeniedDetail.EncodedDiagnosticMessage`字段中获取的编码诊断信息。该参数用于解码无权限诊断信息，调用本接口时需传入
parameters.name: encoded_diagnostic_message

AuthAction.description_en: The action used for authentication in the user request
AuthAction.description_zh: 用户请求中用于鉴权的操作信息

AuthConditions.description_zh: 用户请求中用于鉴权的条件列表

ConditionValues.description_zh: 鉴权条件Key对应的值列表

items.description_en: A condition value corresponding to the authentication condition key
items.description_zh: 鉴权条件Key对应的条件值

AuthPrincipal.description_en: The principal used for authentication in the user request
AuthPrincipal.description_zh: 用户请求中用于鉴权的主体信息

AuthPrincipalDisplayName.description_en:
The identity identifier used for authentication in the user request, as follows:

RAM user: The UID of the RAM user.

RAM role: The role name and role session name (for example, RoleName:RoleSessionName).

SSO federated identity: The identity provider type and name (for example, saml-provider/AzureAD)
AuthPrincipalDisplayName.description_zh:
用户请求中用于鉴权的身份标识。具体如下：

RAM用户：提供的是RAM用户的UID信息。
RAM角色：提供的是角色名称和角色会话名称（例如：RoleName:RoleSessionName）。
SSO联合身份：提供的是身份提供商类型和身份提供商名称（例如：saml-provider/AzureAD）

AuthPrincipalOwnerId.description_en: The Alibaba Cloud account UID of the identity used for authentication in the user request
AuthPrincipalOwnerId.description_zh: 用户请求中用于鉴权的身份所属的阿里云账号UID信息

AuthPrincipalType.description_en: The identity type used for authentication in the user request
AuthPrincipalType.description_zh: 用户请求中用于鉴权的身份类型

AuthResource.description_en: The resource used for authentication in the user request
AuthResource.description_zh: 用户请求中用于鉴权的资源信息

ExplicitDeny.description_en: Indicates whether the denial is explicit

MatchedPolicies.description_en: The list of policies matched during authentication

AttachedEntityType.description_en: The entity type to which the policy is attached

AttachedScope.description_en: The scope to which the policy is attached

PolicyIdentifier.description_en:
The policy name, as follows:

Control policy: The control policy ID.

RAM access policy: The access policy name
PolicyIdentifier.description_zh:
策略名称信息。具体如下：
管控策略：管控策略ID。
RAM权限策略：权限策略名称

PolicyVersion.description_en:
The policy version number.

Only custom policies have version numbers
PolicyVersion.description_zh:
策略版本号。
仅自定义策略有版本号

NoPermissionPolicyType.description_zh: 产生无权限的策略类型
